description: Template compliance contracts for Phase 3 Architecture & Technical Specs documents
match_note: required_sections uses 'startswith' matching — check if output section heading starts with the pattern. Section numbers (§6+) may shift when architects add project-specific sections (e.g. WebSocket, Real-time Integration). Patterns without trailing specifics (e.g. '## 6. Endpoints By') match any variation.

P3-01-architecture.description: Thiết kế kiến trúc tổng thể — tech decisions, system diagram, data ownership
required_sections: ## 2. Sơ Đồ Kiến Trúc Hệ Thống
## 5. Giao Tiếp Giữa Các Phân Hệ
## 6. Các Quy Ước Áp Dụng Toàn Hệ Thống

api-contract.description: API contract — conventions, response envelopes, endpoints by system
api-contract.notes: §6 pattern '## 6. Endpoints By' matches 'By System', 'By Module', etc. §7 pattern '## 7. Internal' matches 'Internal API', 'Internal Service Calls', etc. If author adds a new section between §5 and §8 (e.g. WebSocket), §6-8 will be renumbered — audit should WARN not FAIL.

database-design.description: Database design — schema organization, DDL, migration strategy
database-design.notes: Section 3 is system-specific tables — heading varies per project (e.g. '## 3. CRM Tables'). Use startswith '## 3.' matching

integration-map.description: Integration map — sync/async calls, event payloads, cross-system rules
integration-map.notes: §6-9 may be renumbered if author inserts a project-specific section (e.g. Real-time Integration, WebSocket) between §5 and §6. Content equivalence check is more reliable than strict number matching for §6+.

infra-spec.description: Infrastructure spec — environments, server specs, monitoring, NFR targets
infra-spec.notes: §6-9 names may vary per project (CI/CD Pipeline, Monitoring & Observability, Security Hardening, NFR Targets). Health Check content may appear inside Monitoring section. Audit these by content presence rather than strict heading match.

stakeholder-review.description: Stakeholder review — technical cross-review, consistency, gap analysis
